ReznorSignCode.name: Reznor ring: sign and level end
summary: Second half of the Reznor main code (entered for every Reznor/platform slot). Only sprite slot 7 runs this part: it positions the Reznor sign,
advances the ring angle [$37,$36] (0-$1FF) by one per frame and, once the level end timer [$163E,X] reaches 1, ends the fight:
stops Mario walking, starts the end of level timer [$1493] and plays the clear music ([$1DFB] = $0B).

ReznorNoLevelEnd.name: Reznor: check all Reznors dead
summary: Adds the four dead flags. When all four Reznors are dead, sets the level end timer [$163E,X] = $90, removes all other sprites and clears the extended sprites.
Then, for every Reznor slot, places the Reznor and its platform on the ring (see ReznorAlive) or skips to drawing if the status is not 8.

ReznorAlive.name: Reznor: fire timer
summary: Reached for a live Reznor. Counts [$1570,X] every frame (unless turning) and every 256 frames sets the firing timer [$1558,X] = $40.

NoSetRznrFireTime.name: Reznor: face Mario
summary: Every 64 frames (staggered per slot), if not firing or turning, faces Mario; a direction change starts the turning timer [$15AC,X] = $0A.

NoSetRenrTurnTime.name: Reznor: Mario contact
summary: Interacts with Mario unless [$154C,X] (disable interaction) is running. Contact sets it to 8 and compares Mario Y - sprite Y: far above = hurts Mario
(HitReznor), at the platform edge or moving down = side bounce, moving up from below = platform bounce that kills this Reznor.

HitPlatBottom.name: Mario hits platform from below
summary: Starts the platform bounce timer [$1564,X] = $0F, knocks Mario down (Y speed $10) and plays a sound. KillReznor runs when the timer reaches $0C.

HitPlatSide.name: Mario bounces off platform side
summary: Sets Mario X speed from ReboundSpeedX (indexed by the side Mario is on), then draws.

HitReznor.name: Hurt Mario, then draw Reznor
summary: Hurts Mario then falls into DrawReznor.

DrawReznor.name: Reznor: pick frame and draw
summary: Chooses the frame in [$1602,X]: 0 normal, 1 firing, 2 turning (direction temporarily flipped while the turn timer >= 5). Fires a fireball when the firing timer = $20, draws via ReznorGfxRt and kills the Reznor when the platform bounce timer = $0C.

ReznorTurning.name: Reznor: turning frame
summary: Sets frame 2 (turning).

ReznorNoTurning.name: Reznor: firing check
summary: If the firing timer [$1558,X] is non-zero, fires a fireball when it equals $20 and uses frame 1.

ReznorFiring.name: Reznor: firing frame
summary: Sets frame 1 (firing).

ReznorNoFiring.name: Reznor: draw and kill check
summary: Draws, restores the sprite direction, then returns unless sprites are not locked, the Reznor is alive and the bounce timer = $0C.

KillReznor.name: Kill Reznor
summary: Plays a sound, records the death in [$151C,X] and spawns a falling dead Reznor (sprite $A9, status 2) at the same position with Y speed $C0 (bounces up). Returns if no free sprite slot.

ReznorFireRt.name: Reznor: find free fireball slot
summary: Finds a free extended sprite slot (7 down to 0) and falls into FoundRznrFireSlot; returns if none.

FoundRznrFireSlot.name: Spawn Reznor fireball
summary: Creates extended sprite 2 (Reznor fireball) at Reznor position (-8, -$14), aims it at Mario with speed $10 using CODE_0397F9 and stores the speeds.

ReznorGfxRt.name: Draw Reznor
summary: Draws the four 16x16 tiles of Reznor (frame from [$1602,X], mirrored by direction) and then his platform. A dead Reznor only draws the platform.

RznrGfxLoopStart.name: Reznor draw: tile loop
summary: Loop over the 4 tiles of the frame (X = 3..0): OAM position from the offset tables, tile and properties from ReznorTiles/ReznorPal.

NoReznorGfxFlip.name: Reznor draw: finish OAM
summary: Writes properties, advances the OAM index by 4 and finishes with FinishOAMWrite (4 tiles, 16x16).

DrawReznorPlats.name: Draw Reznor platform
summary: Calls ReznorPlatGfxRt.

ReznorPlatGfxRt.name: Draw Reznor platform graphics
summary: Reserves 4 OAM slots for Reznor, then draws two 16x16 tiles ($4E, the right one X flipped) for the platform; Y is lowered by the bounce table indexed by [$1564,X] >> 1.

InvisBlk+DinosMain.name: Dino sprite main entry (and invisible block)
summary: Entry point shared by sprites $6D (Invisible solid block) , $6E (Dino-Rhino) and $6F (Dino-Torch). Sprite $6D calls InvisBlkMainRt; the Dinos go to DinoMainRt.

DinoMainRt.name: Dino main wrapper
summary: Sets the data bank to the program bank around DinoMainSubRt.

DinoMainSubRt.name: Dino main code
summary: Draws, returns if sprites are locked or status is not 8, handles offscreen, Mario contact and movement, then runs the state: 0 walk, 1/2 breathe fire (Dino-Torch only), 3 jump.

RhinoStatePtrs.name: Pointer table: Dino states, wall nudge
summary: State pointers for Dino-Rhino/Dino-Torch, plus DATA_039C6E/71 (X nudge out of walls) and the state 3 jump code CODE_039C74.

DinoSpeed.name: Dino walking states and speeds
summary: DinoSpeed table: X speeds for Rhino ($08/$F8) and Torch ($10/$F0). CODE_039CA8 is state 0 (walk): on the ground, Dino-Torch starts a flame ([$1540,X] = $FF, state 1 or 2) when the timer is 0;
every 64 frames it faces Mario; it jumps (Y speed $C0, state 3) when it hits a wall.

DinoFlameTable.name: Table: Dino-Torch flame animation
summary: 32 entries per flame state (1 = horizontal, 2 = vertical), indexed by [$1540,X] / 8 so played from the end: high nibble = flame size (0 = full flame that hurts Mario), low nibble = frame for [$1602,X].

DinoFlameTimerSet.name: Dino-Torch breathing flame (state 1/2)
summary: Stands still and runs the flame from timer [$1540,X] ($FF down to 0): sound at $C0, frame and size from DinoFlameTable. When the flame is full and every 4th frame, checks contact with the flame box and hurts Mario unless he has a star.

DinoFlame1.name: Table: flame box X offset low

DinoFlame2.name: Table: flame box X offset high

DinoFlame4.name: Table: flame box Y offset low

DinoFlame5.name: Table: flame box Y offset high

DinoFlameClipping.name: Dino-Torch flame hitbox
summary: Fills the sprite clipping slot B ($04 X low, $0A X high, $06 width, $05 Y low, $0B Y high, $07 height) from the DinoFlame tables, indexed by frame - 2 (+2 when the sprite direction is 0).

DinoSetGfxFrame.name: Dino walk animation frame
summary: Increments the animation counter [$1570,X] and sets the frame [$1602,X] to bit 3 of it (0/1, every 8 frames).

DinoRhinoTileDispX.name: Table: Dino body tile X offsets

DinoRhinoTileDispY.name: Table: Dino body tile Y offsets
